```renyi
public function total(invoice: Invoice) returns Decimal
  purpose: Subtotal after the percentage discount, rounded to cents.
  see also: subtotal

  let subtotal be subtotal(invoice)
  let discount be subtotal * invoice.discount_percent / 100
  return (subtotal - discount).rounded(2)
end
```
